summary: A single-threaded Observable<T> with sink, map, remove_duplicates and cancel-on-drop subscriptions covers the CurrentValueSubject and @Published cases. PassthroughSubject has filter, map, merge, flat_map, debounce and throttle, and combine_latest is a free function. receive(on:), back pressure and threading are missing.

features.apple: Publisher, Publishers (map, filter, merge, combineLatest, debounce...)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. map and remove_duplicates on Observable; filter, merge, flat_map, debounce and throttle on PassthroughSubject; combine_latest as a free function Built 2026-10-17: PassthroughSubject merge(with:) (merge) and flat_map for inner publishers that replay synchronously (Finite); tests springboard/sdk/src/observable.rs::merge_flat_map_tests. Built 2026-10-17: debounce and throttle(latest:) on a main-thread RunLoop (springboard/sdk/src/run_loop.rs, advanced by the app tick); tests in springboard/sdk/src/observable.rs and run_loop.rs. flatMap with Future inners is built (flat_map_future, resolution order). LocalScheduler (run_loop.rs) is the main-thread scheduler; debounce and throttle take it. Not done: receive(on:) and subscribe(on:), since publishers are single-threaded by design.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. Observable<T> plays @Published; no AnyPublisher erasure
cancel on drop and store(in:) bag

A Scheduler trait with schedule and schedule_after, an immediate scheduler and every dispatch queue as a scheduler; tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-08.rs. Gap: no receive(on:) or subscribe(on:) operators, because Observable is Rc and single-threaded; the run loop is the main queue, not a separate type.

gaps: Operators beyond map, filter, merge, flatMap, debounce, throttle and combineLatest (for example scan, compactMap, zip)
receive(on:) and subscribe(on:); schedulers are a main-thread RunLoop and DispatchQueue, and no operator moves a publisher between them
Demand and back pressure (Subscribers.Demand); completions and failures exist only on Finite and Future
ObservableObject objectWillChange is partial: the aggregate publisher emits after the value has changed (observable_object.rs)
